narrative.overview: Repo Agent is a working reference book that happens to be software. The session index is a dark case; the conversation is a paper field; each assistant answer is a milk-acetate leaf punched and tabbed with its section colour. The world is present in the type, the palette, the density, and one signature move — the tabbed leaf and the fore-edge rail — while the navigation, buttons, inputs, and menus stay standard web controls an engineer already knows. The system is professional, restrained, and trustworthy. It refuses the generic white chat shell, the neon dashboard, and glass decoration. Colour is not scattered as accent: the seven section hues are full-strength boards used for tabs, the user's instruction slip, status stamps, and small reading markers. Long-form prose always sits on paper or acetate, never on a saturated field.
keyCharacteristics: Deep-ink index case and a paper reading field.
Milk-acetate assistant leaves with punched holes and section tabs.
A stepped fore-edge rail that tracks message order and reading position.
Three self-hosted voices: Archivo for UI and headings, Source Serif 4 for report prose, Azeret Mono for machine data.
Standard controls, precise rules, and steps(2) motion; no easing curves.

rules.name: The One Board Rule
rules.body: Saturated section hues belong to tabs, the user slip, status stamps, and small boards. Long-form reading fields are always paper or acetate.

rules.name: The Errata Rule
rules.body: Vermilion is for errors, destructive actions, and approval risk. It never becomes an accent colour.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Report prose stays near 70ch and never stretches across the full desktop width. A wide window earns margin, not longer lines.

rules.name: The Machine Voice Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for code, data, measurement, names, and IDs — never for long prose or decorative "technical" labels.

rules.name: The Printed Edge Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from a 1px rule, a short soft shadow, and the material of the sheet — not from a floating card with a large radius.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: No coloured halos, neon edges, or ambient glows. Status colour sits in a dot or a stamp, not in light.

dos: Do keep report prose on Source Serif 4 at 16.5px/1.75 with a ~70ch measure.
Do use full-strength section hues on tabs, stamps, the user slip, and small boards only.
Do keep the fore-edge rail aligned to message order and message extent, and let the active tab extend.
Do use the three self-hosted faces and the tab/leaf material as the signature.
Do keep standard web controls, visible focus rings, and prefers-reduced-motion support.
Do use SVG icons in one 1.75px stroke and label every icon-only button.
donts: Don't introduce rounded chat bubbles, gradient text, glass panels, neon glows, or emoji icons.
Don't put long-form text on a saturated hue or use a saturated hue as a page wash.
Don't use vermilion as an accent; it is reserved for errors, destructive actions, and approval risk.
Don't replace standard navigation, inputs, or menus with manual/costume chrome.
Don't bring back the old green/white ChatGPT palette or the generic white-shell composition.
Don't add large radii, pill cards, or floating glass surfaces; depth is a printed edge and a short soft shadow.
